    n = len(edges)
    visited = [False] * n
    edges.sort(key=lambda x: x[2])  # Sort edges by weight in ascending order
    parent = [-1] * n
    parent[0] = 0
    parent[1] = 0
    total_cost = 0
    edge_ending = -1

    for edge in edges:
        if visited[edge[0]] and visited[edge[1]] and parent[edge[1]] == parent[edge[0]]:
            continue
        if visited[edge[0]] or visited[edge[1]]:
            edge_ending = -1
            break
        if edge_ending == -1:

            total_cost += edge[2]
            parent[edge[0]] = edge[1]
            parent[edge[1]] = edge[0]
        else:

                edge_ending = -1
                break
            parent[edge[0]] = edge[1]
            parent[edge[1]] = edge[0]
    else:
        if edge_ending == -1 and len(edges) == 1:  # If edge_ending is -1 and there's only one edge

    cycle = False
    edge_ending == -1
    leaf_nodes = []

            cycle = True
            break

    if any(leaf == 0 for leaf in leaf_nodes):  # Check for cycle and other conditions
        return None

    permutation = [parent[parent_i] + 1 for parent_i in range(n)]
    if any(parent_i < parent[parent_i - 1] for parent_i in range(1, n)):
        permutation.reverse()

    return permutation
